platform.description: Post-rebrand Windows-checkout source contracts, rolled forward for issue #133 named layouts after auditing the session parser changes. The parser keeps the reviewed .allocate = .alloc_always ownership fix and adds a layout-only parse path that strips window placement before validation; the on-disk schema remains unchanged at v1. Hashes reflect checkout normalization. This git_commit exists only on the PR branch: after a squash-merge it becomes unreachable and Test-VerificationContracts.ps1 skips the git-diff cross-check while the sha256 check still runs, so re-point it at the merge commit on main (see RECONCILE-SESSION-STATE.md).
